run_starcraft_generate_tfrecords: run the starcraft CLI tool to generate a test.tfrecords file with 20 random frames at 64x64 resolution
run_starcraft_train_split: run the starcraft CLI tool to generate train_0.tfrecords with configurable resolution and output path
run_starcraft_validation_split: run the starcraft CLI tool to generate valid.tfrecords for Starcraft dataset validation split
run_starcraft_custom_resolution: run the starcraft CLI tool with custom resolution flag to generate tfrecords at specified dimensions
test_starcraft_tfrecord_output: test the starcraft CLI tool output by verifying the generated tfrecords file contains valid SequenceExample data
